title: client silent-disconnect detection and graceful rejoin protocol with toolcall idempotency
text:
client silent-disconnect detection and graceful rejoin protocol with toolcall idempotency

description:
Motivation: client sockets can silently drop (TCP RST, NAT timeouts, mobile backgrounding) which leads to duplicate tool/function calls or lost structured output when clients attempt an immediate reconnect. This PR introduces a server-side silent-disconnect detector, a short-lived rejoin token protocol for safe resume, and defenses to ensure tool/function calls remain idempotent across reconnects. Key behaviors: 1) Heartbeat/keepalive: server now tracks per-session last-activity and emits a 'quiesce' state after configurable grace_window (default 18s). 2) Rejoin token: on session creation the server issues a short-lived rejoin token bound to a session_id and lease; clients reconnecting present Rejoin-Token + Last-Event-ID to resume stream without reexecuting completed tool calls. 3) Tool idempotency ledger: function/tool calls now carry an Idempotency-Key; server persists call results for the token lease window and fences duplicate execution. 4) Buffered event replay: the server persists the final structured output envelope and last N events to replay to reconnecting clients, with integrity markers (sequence numbers + crc32) to detect mismatch. 5) Compatibility: OpenAI compatibility layer accepts Rejoin-Token via 'x-openai-rejoin-token' header and maps legacy 'last-event-id' query param. 6) Config: per-route conservative/aggressive reconnection policies and a feature-flag for rolling this out. The description below summarizes changes, tests, and rollout plan.

review_comments:
Diego: Please add a test that simulates rapid connect/disconnect to catch race window between quiesce and ledger eviction. Meera: We should not make the default lease > 30s without perf justification. Security: ensure token entropy and bind to session origin.
Author (Ava): Added a stress test in test_rejoin_idempotency.py and reduced default lease to 18s; reworked token to include origin fingerprint.
Diego: LGTM after addressing the stress test flake and a small refactor to the ledger removal path. Meera: approving, couple of doc nits fixed.

ci_notes:
First CI run failed due to a timing-dependent e2e flake in test_rejoin_idempotency; increased test wait and added deterministic clock in the test harness; rerun passed.

release_notes:
Added graceful session quiesce detection and a Rejoin Token protocol for safer reconnects; clients can present x-openai-rejoin-token and last-event-id to resume streams without causing duplicate tool/function calls. Default rejoin lease is 18s and per-route policy controls are available. This reduces duplicated tool calls on flaky networks and improves streaming resilience.

rollout_plan:
Default off for 24h canary on prod, enable for 20% of traffic in region-us-west for 72h, monitor session.quiesced, toolcall.duplicate_rate, and reconnect.latency then proceed to 100% over one week; SDK releases provide opt-in helpers.
